svg.title: The m-devbox stack
svg.desc: One container holding, from the top: your browser, with VS Code, the m-vscode extension and an AI assistant; your code; the M Standard Library; m, the toolchain; the driver; and the M engine with its database.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: m-devbox: the whole M stack in one container
